question: Choose the antonym of ‘scrupulous’:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dishonest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"scrupulous"** means someone who is diligent, thorough, and extremely attentive to details, or someone who adheres strictly to moral principles. (ईमानदार और नैतिक रूप से सावधान)

 
 
• **Example:** The lawyer was scrupulous in preparing the case, ensuring no detail was overlooked.
 
 
 
• **"Dishonest"** refers to someone who is not truthful, who engages in fraud or deceit, or who lacks moral principles. (बेईमान)
 
 
• **Example:** The employee was fired for being dishonest about his work hours.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"scrupulous"** is **"dishonest"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dishonest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Principled** (सिद्धांतवादी): Someone who strictly adheres to moral and ethical principles.

 
 
• **Example:** He is a principled man who always stands up for what is right.
 
 
 
• **Ethical** (नैतिक): Relating to moral principles or standards of right and wrong.
 
 
• **Example:** The company ensures that all its operations are ethical and transparent.
 
 
 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Showing a lack of attention or concern; neglectful.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless attitude led to several mistakes in the report.
